overview_description.description: ClickPe operates a financial technology marketplace that connects consumers and small businesses with regulated lenders and banks. The company provides a digital platform and mobile app through which users can discover and compare loans, credit cards, savings accounts, and other credit products. Its infrastructure supports paperless onboarding, automated eligibility checks, and digital application flows that reduce manual documentation. For micro and small merchants, ClickPe offers access to SME business loans and daily repayment structures integrated with digital wallets. It also aggregates credit card offers, savings account products, and secured lending such as loans against property. The platform works with RBI-registered NBFCs, cooperative banks, and other financial institutions to route applications and manage disbursement. ClickPe focuses on streamlining credit discovery, loan aggregation, and repayment management for underserved retail and SME segments.
